messages:
sara: Heads-up: tactical freeze starts 23:20 UTC for the EU cutover tonight. Need confirmations for pins, smoke, and rollback readiness.

alex: Pin confirmed -> model=rd-model v3.4.1; prod-eu feature flag `featureX=false`. Canary traffic plan 1% -> 10% -> 25% -> 100%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled
```
job: canary-3170007777
target: prod-eu
image: inference-service:v3.4.1
traffic: 1%
```

jamie: Quick owner checklist: 1) run smoke health + sample inference, 2) dry-run migrations, 3) verify alert subscriptions. I'm running smoke now.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Infra check OK 49a GPU pool eu: 16 nodes available, autoscaler headroom 5 nodes.

morgan: Rollback artifact ready: tag rollback/prod-eu-2026-03-21 sha=abcdef1234. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/rollbacks/prod-eu

alex: Alert rule: fail canary if 5xx > 1.5% OR p50 latency increase > 35% over baseline -> revert to v3.4.0 and notify #incidents.

sara: I'll coordinate. Owners set status and stay oncall during freeze (23:20-01:00 UTC). If canary green at T+10m we ramp to 10%, at T+35m to 25%, full at T+70m. Any anomaly -> rollback.

jamie: Smoke logs: `kubectl -n prod-eu logs -l job=smoke-canary --tail=200` -> no errors, sample outputs within expected token cost.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started 23:22 UTC. Live metrics: https://observability.redwood/canary/3170007777

morgan: Rollback command staged:
```
./ops/rollback_to.sh --sha abcdef1234 --region eu --notify
```

alex: Manual unpin step if needed: `rd pins unset model rd-model --env prod`. I'll have creds ready to execute within 2min.

sara: Midpoint check in at 23:32 UTC. If silent, assume green and proceed with ramp. I'll post final release note to #release-notes after full traffic.

jamie: noted, will keep posting short status updates.

morgan: On-call until 01:30 UTC for post-rollout watch.

sara: Thanks team :thumbsup: will call rollback if any threshold breaches.

alex: Acknowledged and standing by.
